landing.heroSubtitle: Get your devices fixed by certified technicians. Fast, reliable, and affordable repair services for all your tech needs.
landing.ctaBody: Submit your repair request now and our team will get back to you within 24 hours.

submit.title: Submit Repair Request
submit.body: Fill out the form with your device details and upload images.

review.title: Technician Review
review.body: Our experts review your request and diagnose the issue.

estimate.title: Receive Price Estimate
estimate.body: Get a transparent cost estimate and repair timeline.

send.title: Send Device
send.body: Choose to bring it to our store or request courier pickup.

repaired.title: Device Repaired
repaired.body: We repair your device and notify you when it's ready.

form.title: Submit Repair Request

success.body: Our technicians will review your request shortly. You'll receive an email confirmation at
